next.reason: 1985: "LABEL { RECORD IS | RECORDS ARE } { STANDARD | OMITTED } VALUE OF implementor-name-1 IS { data-name-1 | literal-1 } …"; 2023: "Format 3 (report): FD file-name-1 [ IS EXTERNAL [ AS literal-1 ] ] [ IS GLOBAL ] [BLOCK…] [ record-clause ] [CODE-SET…] REPORT IS". The 2023 report FD (Format 3) drops LABEL RECORDS and VALUE OF. It adds EXTERNAL, GLOBAL, CODE-SET FOR NATIONAL and the broader RECORD clause (VARYING, BYTES).
